title.narrative: Advisory Services

description.narrative: Achieved. Launched in 2021 but experienced issues with quality, and overlap/duplication with other TA providers. Each of the CoPs launched one ASP in 2021, but finalization slipped to June 2022. The third ASP was launched by the BCoP in February 2022. All were published during CY2022 and included: Three Advisory Services Projects (2 for BCOP and 1 for TCOP).After considering the pros and cons and given the low demand from the member countries for the service, and issues with quality etc., ASPs have been discontinued since CY2023 and PEMNA refocused back to peerlearning and research activities.

title.narrative: Knowledge exchange among budget and treasury officials to increase their capacity for better Public Financial Management.

description.narrative: The overall objective (PDO) of PEMNA2 is to facilitate knowledge exchange among budget and treasury officials to increase their capacity for better Public Financial Management. There are 2 indicators for this and the related results status is listed for each below:1) PFM practices shared that have led to improvements in PFM in member countriesIn progress. 2 member countries already confirmed improvement in PFM practices because of knowledge shared in PEMNA. Additional surveys / interviews will be conducted by the PEMNA Secretariat to assess the progress2) Percentage of participants that recognize that the knowledge shared has allowed them to influence PFM practices in their countries.Achieved and exceeded, needs to be sustained. More than 90% of participants responding to the event evaluation surveys recognize that the knowledge shared has allowed them to influence PFM practices in their countries
